Per-frame button presses for one player

Source: R/movie_class.R
player.Rd

Per-frame button presses for one player

Usage

player(movie, idx = 1L)

Arguments

movie

A replayr_movie (returned by read_movie() or any of the format-specific readers).

idx

Player index, 1-based. Defaults to 1 (player 1).

Value

Logical matrix, n_frames(movie) rows by n_buttons(movie) columns. Column names are the universal-button mnemonics.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  mv <- read_movie("data/raw_nes/super_mario_bros/1349.fm2")
  p1 <- player(mv)
  colSums(p1)        # number of frames each button was held
} # }
